Jazzy 1450 Heavy Duty Power Chair by Pride Mobility JAZZY1450
Are you looking for a powerful heavy duty power chair with the highest weight capacity on the market today?  Well, you have found it!  Introducing Pride Mobility's Jazzy 1450 Heavy Duty Front Wheel Drive Power Chair.  This power chair offers a 600 lbs weight capacity, is built like a tank, and has super heavy duty motors to give you the power you need to get through your day.  This powerful machine is capable of handling just about any type of terrain with ease.
HEAVY DUTY TIRES & LARGE FOOTPLATE:
The Jazzy 1450 comes with large 14" knobby tires that are also 4" wide.  This gives this power chair the ability to go through high grass and tackle tougher terrains than any other chair on the market today.  It also comes with 9" rear caster wheels and 4" front anti-tip wheels for added stability and support.
For added comfort, this power chair also has an extra large footplate that is 12" x 14".  It is heavy duty, made of all metal, and flips up, making it easier to get in and out of the unit.  The armrests on this unit are adjustable as well.  You can flip them up, making it easier to get in and out of the unit.  Plus, they are also extendable outward, giving the user more of a seating area and added comfort.
ULTRA COMFORTABLE SEAT & HEAVY DUTY SUSPENSION:
In order to ride over different types of terrain in comfort, it is essential you have a suspension system to help ease the feeling of those bumps.  Not only do you need a suspension, but it has to be heavy duty with a chair built like this one.  Pride has you covered in that area as well with its front spring suspension system.
Another important benefit this front wheel drive power chair has is its plush high back seat.  The seat size ranges to accommodate any type of person and even goes up to 32" x 28" as the largest seat size available.  The back on this seat has the ability to tilt back and folds down flat against the seat making it more compact for easier storage or transport.  Even the headrest is adjustable, so you can raise it or lower it, giving you the most comfortable position for your head and neck.
GREAT PERFORMANCE & BEST IN CLASS WARRANTY:
The Jazzy 1450 can actually go faster than most other bariatric power chairs on the market at 4.5 mph.  Additionally, it offers an impressive battery range of up to 15.7 miles on a single charge, so you can be out and about all day without needing to recharge.  This rugged power chair is designed to last and is covered by an extensive warranty that includes 18-month coverage on drive motors, plus Pride Mobility includes one year of in home service for the first year of owning the unit.
